tagline: Global leader in pharmaceutical packaging and drug delivery systems
hero_kpi_rationale: Key performance indicator reflecting the group's solid organic growth in its pharmaceutical segments, supported by improvement in operating margins and controlled geographic expansion.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company over the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Revenue reached 2.0 billion euros for fiscal year 2023, up 3.5% compared to the prior year.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth in pharmaceutical segments.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin expanded 80 basis points to 34.5%, driven by manufacturing efficiency gains in plants.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reached 15.2%, up 50 basis points due to improved fixed cost management.

kpis.name: R&D Spending as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D spending represented 1.8% of revenue, concentrated on advanced administration systems.
kpis.signal: Targeted R&D focused on advanced delivery systems innovation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending for acquisition or modernization of tangible assets.
kpis.description: Capital investments totaled 180 million euros, up 10%, supporting industrial transformation.
kpis.signal: Capex oriented toward digitalization and sustainability.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of collaborators in the group.
kpis.description: The group employed 11,500 employees as of November 2023, slightly up compared to the prior year.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth linked to Asia expansion.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. The company's strategy does not highlight AI as a lever for innovation or transformation.
evidence: No reference to AI in the management report
Absence of AI-related projects in R&D and innovation sections
No mention of advanced automation tools or machine learning
